name: ListTagMetaAsset

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the system. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The tag name. To retrieve the database and table information in a DataAgent workspace, pass the value in the following format: `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`
parameters.help_zh: 标签名字，需要获取DataAgent协作空间下的库表信息，传递格式为 `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en:
The metadata type.
To retrieve the database list, set this parameter to META_DATABASE.
To retrieve the table list of a specific database, set this parameter to META_TABLE
parameters.help_zh:
获取库列表，传递为 META_DATABASE
当获取某个库详情的表列表，传递为 META_TABLE
parameters.name: meta_type

parameters.help_en:
The parent MetaId of the asset.
To retrieve the database list on the left side of the DataAgent data center, you do not need to specify this parameter.
To retrieve the table list of a specific database, set this parameter to the corresponding dbId
parameters.help_zh:
资产对应的父级MetaId：
当获取DataAgent数据中心左侧库列表，此值无需传递
当获取某个库详情的表列表，此值传递为 对应的 dbId
parameters.name: meta_parent_id

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

MetaEntityAttrs.description_en:
The metadata entity attributes.
When MetaType is set to META_DATABASE, the following information is included:
schemaName: the database name. For PostgreSQL databases, this is the schema name.
catalogName: the catalog name. For PostgreSQL databases, this is the database name.
dbId: the DMS database ID.
instanceResourceId: the instance resource ID. If the database is an ApsaraDB RDS instance, this value is the RDS instance ID.
dbType: the DMS database type.

When MetaType is set to META_TABLE, the following information is included:
schemaName: the database name. For PostgreSQL databases, this is the schema name.
catalogName: the catalog name. For PostgreSQL databases, this is the database name.
dbId: the DMS database ID.
dbType: the DMS database type.
tableName: the table name.
tableSchemaName: the table schema name. This parameter is valid only for SQL Server databases
MetaEntityAttrs.description_zh:
MetaType=META_DATABASE时包含如下信息：
schemaName：库名，PG系为schema名
catalogName：PG系为库名
dbId：DMS dbId
instanceResourceId：实例资源id，如果是RDS，此值为RDS实例id
dbType：DMS dbType

MetaType=META_TABLE时包含如下信息：
schemaName：库名，PG系为schema名
catalogName：PG系为库名
dbId：DMS dbId
dbType：DMS dbType
tableName：表名
tableSchemaName：表架构名，SQLServer下才有效

MetaType.description_en:
The metadata type. Valid values:
META_DATABASE: database information.
META_TABLE: table information

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when an error occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回
